release_notes_zh:
修复：应用内自动更新在网络慢或抖动时下载失败
- 更新包下载不再因连接被重置而失败：从已下载字节处断点续传，最多 24 次尝试，间隔逐步放宽到 6 秒
- 下载使用独立的超时预算（连接 20 秒、等待响应 60 秒、单次读取 60 秒，无总时长限制）
- 下载完成按 SHA-256 校验，校验通过才启动安装程序
- 连接在最后一个字节之后才断开时直接校验已下载内容，不再误报失败
- 更新检查的清单请求超时从 5 秒放宽到 15 秒，失败时最多重试 3 轮

包含 0.1.2 的内容
- 批量裁剪与导出：开始与结束时间都能完整输入，不再数字乱跳
- 分割方式改为 录制时间 / 真实时间，每行显示时长与两种口径的换算
- 真实时间在对话框内换算成录制内秒数，通宵录制支持次日时间，也可写完整日期

说明
- 安装包由 Inno Setup 7 制作，可直接覆盖安装，用户数据保留在 %APPDATA%\TrueRespi
release_notes_en:
Fixed: in-app auto-update failed to download on a slow or unstable link
- The installer download now resumes from the bytes already received after a dropped connection: up to 24 attempts with the delay widening to 6 s
- Downloads use their own timeout budget (20 s connect, 60 s to first response, 60 s per read, no total limit)
- The finished download is verified with SHA-256 before the installer is launched
- A connection that drops after the final byte no longer fails the update; the bytes on disk are verified directly
- The update-check manifest request now allows 15 s instead of 5 s and retries up to 3 rounds

Includes the 0.1.2 changes
- Batch crop dialog: start and end times can both be typed without characters jumping
- Split modes renamed to Recording time / Real time, with length and cross-reference per range
- Real clock times are converted to recording offsets in the dialog; overnight times and explicit dates are accepted

Notes
- The installer is built with Inno Setup 7 and installs over an existing copy; user data stays in %APPDATA%\TrueRespi
